content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Recent revelations about data breaches and privacy violations have sparked a nationwide debate about the ethical responsibilities of tech companies.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The scandal has exposed the extent to which major technology firms collect and use personal information without sufficient transparency or consent.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Consumer advocates are calling for stronger regulations to hold these corporations accountable and protect individual privacy.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Industry leaders maintain that they take user privacy seriously and are working to improve their practices.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Tech analyst Greene noted, 'The tech industry must do more to earn back the trust of the public.'
